commit_message: Version 4.0
input_features: Raw ECEF coordinates, SP3 clock errors, temporal lags
problem_addressed: Initial exploration of multi-step satellite orbit and clock error forecasting using deep learning.
change_introduced: Implemented PyTorch BiLSTM, Transformer, and Diffusion architectures with Optuna hyperparameter tuning.
result: Established automated data pipeline and baseline neural modeling for multi-satellite ephemeris errors.
performance_change: NA (Initial baseline inception)
limitation: Heavy dependence on external SP3/RINEX ingestion; uncalibrated for small competition datasets.
next_step: Transition to official PS-08 competition datasets and direct residual error modeling.
notes: Project originally named Gaitonde / early NeuroNav foundation prior to official PS-08 challenge orientation.

commit_message: Major Upgradations and Hybrid Model Addition
input_features: Single-target lag windows with StandardScaler
problem_addressed: Assess external pre-trained OrbitIQ neural weights against the PS-08 training distributions.
change_introduced: Integrated scripts/evaluate_orbitiq.py to run pre-trained HDF5 models on PS-08 error files.
result: Evaluated across 142 epochs. 3D Position Error Mean: 8.0927 m, W_avg: 0.9164.
performance_change: comparable; lower 3D error than initial BiLSTM on training distributions
limitation: Models trained on separate data distribution; severe normality rejections on MEO-2 (p < 1e-7).
next_step: Evaluate native machine learning models on Day-8 out-of-sample holdouts.
notes: Pretrained LSTM models evaluated individually per coordinate axis.

commit_message: Major Upgradations and Hybrid Model Addition
input_features: Single-target lag windows with StandardScaler
problem_addressed: Direct comparison between ensemble decision trees and recurrent neural networks on error series.
change_introduced: Trained RandomForestRegressor alongside LSTM in evaluate_orbitiq.py.
result: MEO-2 3D error dramatically lower (0.1577m vs 1.4215m), but W_avg on MEO-2 dropped to 0.9538.
performance_change: comparable; superior 3D precision on MEO-2, comparable on GEO and MEO-1
limitation: Tree-based models cannot extrapolate trends outside historical bounds.
next_step: Construct multi-model Day-8 holdout evaluation with Shapiro-Wilk ranking.
notes: Random forest showed strong precision on small residual magnitudes.

commit_message: Major Upgradations and Hybrid Model Addition
input_features: Causal lags, elapsed time, harmonic frequencies
problem_addressed: First rigorous out-of-sample Day-8 benchmark across all 6 candidate models following Note.pdf rules.
change_introduced: Built scripts/benchmark_ps08.py executing standardized 7-day train / Day-8 test protocol with exact deduplication.
result: Harmonic Ridge achieved highest W_avg (0.848832) with lowest rejections (7/12).
performance_change: comparable; Harmonic Ridge won on normality despite GP having lower MAE (5.94m vs 6.27m)
limitation: Global model ranking across satellites ignored satellite-specific physical variations.
next_step: Address data pipeline leakage and investigate large GEO excursion dynamics.
notes: First implementation of Note.pdf three-tier evaluation criteria (Shapiro W -> Mean/Std -> Q-Q).

commit_message: Pipeline Leakage Control
input_features: Strictly causal features; no future leakage
problem_addressed: Risk of data leakage across train/validation splits, scaler fitting on test statistics, and irregular cadence gaps.
change_introduced: Restricted scaler fitting strictly to training historical window; purged sequence windows crossing gaps; tracked row-level predictions.
result: Guaranteed zero forward-looking target contamination; verified by tests/test_data_pipeline.py.
performance_change: not_comparable (Data pipeline leakage fix; ensures validity of subsequent scores)
limitation: GEO error excursions remained unmodeled by static linear and recurrent baselines.
next_step: Develop GEO regime-aware architecture to capture non-stationary excursion physics.
notes: Ensured mathematical integrity and audit compliance for all subsequent machine learning runs.

commit_message: Addition of GEO Regime Aware Model
input_features: Harmonic orbital base + delta_t time gaps + rolling amplitude regime estimator
physics_features: Temporal gap distribution, orbital period harmonics
problem_addressed: GEO orbit exhibited abrupt ~75m error excursions during Day 8 that degraded global model W scores.
change_introduced: Engineered regime-switching residual forecaster combining base harmonics with excursion gating.
result: Isolated excursion regimes; generated comprehensive geo_diagnostics/ plots and backtests.
performance_change: comparable; provided foundation for Gated Mixture of Experts
limitation: Hard thresholding on regime probabilities caused boundary discontinuity.
next_step: Formulate continuous Gated Mixture of Experts (MoE) with soft routing.
notes: Proved that GEO orbit requires specialized regime modeling distinct from MEO satellites.

commit_message: Complete GEO Gated MoE model and PS-08 Day-8 benchmark evaluation
milestone_name: GEO Gated Mixture of Experts Benchmark
input_features: Harmonic queries, lag sequences, gating routing weights
problem_addressed: Overcome static model limitations on GEO excursions using adaptive mixture of expert networks.
change_introduced: Implemented GEOGatedMoE with smooth gating network routing between nominal harmonic dynamics and excursion states.
result: GEO Gated MoE won overall benchmark (W_avg = 0.848836, GEO W = 0.802533), beating Harmonic Ridge.
performance_change: comparable; GEO Gated MoE improved W_avg from 0.848832 to 0.848836 and GEO W to 0.802533
limitation: Evaluated as a single winner across all satellites rather than routing satellite-specific specialists.
next_step: Modularize software package and transition to satellite-specific router architecture.
notes: Demonstrated that mixture-of-experts architecture successfully handles non-stationary orbital excursions.

commit_message: Implement core model accuracy upgrades: harmonic baseline, solar physics, and spectral loss
model: Transformer / BiLSTM with Solar & Spectral Loss
input_features: Temporal harmonics + Sun position + solar incidence angles
physics_features: Sun vector, solar beta angle, shadow factor
problem_addressed: Neural architectures failed to capture orbital periodicities in frequency space and solar transition physics.
change_introduced: Added src/physics.py solar geometry, FFT spectral loss in losses.py, and multi-harmonic basis expansion.
result: Provided mathematical basis for solar radiation pressure and orbital periodic feature engineering.
performance_change: not_comparable (Loss and physics module introduction; validated via unit tests)
limitation: Initial physics calculations were discarded during inference or computed only post-prediction.
next_step: Purge legacy benchmarks and establish formal satellite-specific routing stack.
notes: First introduction of solar geometry and spectral penalty into NeuroNav.

commit_message: Changes in the model selection algorithm
milestone_name: Legacy Benchmark Purge & Clean Data Re-alignment
input_features: Standardized CSV schemas
problem_addressed: Legacy synthetic and downloaded benchmarks (CLEAN_GNSS, ORBITIQ_BENCHMARK) caused architectural bloat.
change_introduced: Purged 13,000+ lines of synthetic benchmarks; moved authentic PS-08 files to root data/.
result: Strict focus on genuine competition evaluation; removed SP3 and external acquisition dependencies.
performance_change: not_comparable (Repository cleanup)
limitation: Pipeline still lacked persistent atomic registry and dedicated satellite routing.
next_step: Construct satellite-specific calibration pipeline, registry, and inference router.
notes: Completely eliminated external-product dependencies.

commit_message: Implement satellite-specific forecasting backend and router
input_features: Temporal features, lag windows
official_selection_priority: Early Calibration Policy (3D Orbit Error MAE)
problem_addressed: Global models cannot optimize differing orbital dynamics; single winner across all satellites was suboptimal.
change_introduced: Built src/forecasting/ with SatelliteModelRegistry, CalibrationPipeline, PredictionRouter, and fail-closed safety.
result: Supported per-satellite model winners; under initial 3D MAE policy, Gaussian Process was selected for all 3 satellites.
performance_change: comparable; achieved lowest 3D MAE (GEO 16.43m, MEO-1 0.31m, MEO-2 0.23m)
limitation: Initial calibration used 3D MAE rather than official Shapiro-Wilk competition hierarchy.
next_step: Align calibration selection strictly with official 3-tier Shapiro-Wilk competition hierarchy.
notes: Architectural shift from global model to satellite-specific winning models.

problem_addressed: Enforce judge-mandated 3-tier hierarchy: Priority 1 Shapiro W -> Priority 2 Mean/Std -> Priority 3 Q-Q Outliers.
change_introduced: Added evaluate_residuals_official_hierarchy(), compare_models_hierarchical(), N-HiTS, and DecoupledClock models.
result: transformer achieved W_avg=0.844758 (Rank 8 for MEO-1).
performance_change: comparable; official competition hierarchy drove selections (N-HiTS won GEO, MoE won MEO-1, RF won MEO-2)
limitation: Physics features were computed only post-prediction and not utilized as model inputs.
next_step: Incorporate genuine orbital physics and solar geometry into model feature inputs.
notes: All 27 candidate model runs recorded with exact per-target W, p, H0, mean, std, outliers, and SISRE.

commit_message: Physics Addition
input_features: Temporal harmonics, causal lag windows, SRP solar geometry features
physics_features: sun_beta_angle, shadow_factor, solar_cos_angle, RIC frame projections
problem_addressed: SRP solar angles and RIC calculations were previously discarded before reaching model input.
change_introduced: Integrated SRP features directly into model feature pipelines, added ProvidedStateProvider, fixed E5 ablation.
result: Registered winner  evaluated in production audit; reproducible deterministic inference verified.
performance_change: comparable; maintained official W_avg while integrating solar radiation physical priors
limitation: Required CSV datasets containing only error measurements without position/velocity state vectors.
next_step: Refactor pipeline to support independent single-satellite uploads without mandatory state vectors.
notes: Comprehensive evaluation report audit with 5,000 bootstrap confidence intervals.

commit_message: Complete single-satellite upload, physics modes, and strict fail-closed routing
model: Hybrid Satellite-Specific Stack (N-HiTS / MoE / Random Forest / Baselines)
satellite: All Satellites (GEO, MEO-1, MEO-2, Custom Uploads)
dataset: User-uploaded CSVs (UTC + errors; optional orbital state)
input_features: UTC timestamps, causal lags, dt_seconds, instantaneous basis projections
physics_features: Symmetric RIC basis (r_z, i_z, c_z), Sun beta angle, shadow factor
official_selection_priority: Official Competition Hierarchy (P1 W_avg -> P2 Bias/Std -> P3 Q-Q Outliers)
selected_model: GEO: nhits; MEO-1: geo_moe; MEO-2: random_forest
problem_addressed: Final production architecture supporting single-satellite uploads without state vectors, explicit physics modes, and strict fail-closed safety.
change_introduced: Integrated train_satellite(), rank_candidates_hierarchically(), instantaneous RIC basis features, fail-closed router, and comprehensive test suite.
result: 131/131 tests passing cleanly across repository; complete separation between backend and Tkinter frontend.
performance_change: comparable; preserves official winning hierarchy while supporting flexible physics modes ('none'|'nominal'|'provided')
limitation: Small sample size on MEO-1 eval (N=6 unique epochs) requires careful ongoing monitoring.
next_step: GUI integration by frontend team using clean public API (api.py).
notes: Verified with 100% test pass rate across 131 tests in ~30s.
